messages:
rachel: flagging a cross-region pin drift we observed after yesterday's staged rollout. us-west had an unexpected unpin for runtime v2.16 while eu-west stayed pinned. can we coordinate a short freeze?

todd: what's the signal? is it telemetry or deploybot noise?

rachel: telemetry: deploy history shows unpin triggered by a stale deploybot webhook retry. no perf signal. just want to avoid asymmetric routing while we audit.

deploybot: deploybot: detected inconsistent pin state across regions for runtime:v2.16. Suggested action: reconcile pinlist and enforce global pin or temporary hold-unpin. Requires release lead confirmation.

release-coordinator: recommend temporary global pin for 30m to give SRE time to reconcile. Will note in release window and hold wider rollout.

sre-north: ops-ack. I'll run reconcile script and mute webhook retries. rollback gates unchanged. propose command to enforce: `deploybot enforce-pin runtime v2.16 --scope global --duration 1800s`

todd: +1. also add a postmortem task to adjust deploybot webhook backoff to avoid duplicate retries.

rachel: executing reconcile now. will post result in this thread.

sre-north: reconcile complete: pin states unified to pinned. webhook retries muted. no perf anomalies observed. lifting manual hold after 30m unless any objections.

release-coordinator: broadcasting brief to #general about temporary global pinlift at +30m. keep this thread as source of truth.

rachel: thanks — follow-up issue created: infra#3421 for webhook backoff and a small test in canary to prevent drift. closing thread after observation window. :white_check_mark:
